title: Concept: Unescaped HTML sink mark_safe (python) — review required
description: In python, mark_safe inserts raw markup into a page. Unescaped sinks turn stored or reflected input into script execution in the victim's session. The python-specific remedy is contextual escaping via conditional_escape or template autoescape.
applicability: python codebases rendering values through mark_safe; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Stored or reflected cross-site scripting when untrusted input reaches the sink; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for stored sinks on authenticated pages.
